name: Automaio
description: AI landing pages for Webflow. Pages are stored as structured JSON on Automaio, rendered server-side, and synced to Webflow CMS as Page ID + SEO metadata. Uses Webflow OAuth and registered inline scripts on collection templates only.
features: JSON page schema (structured sections, not raw HTML in CMS)
Server-side HTML rendering from Automaio API
Webflow CMS: Page ID, SEO title, description, slug, status
OAuth connection (required for custom code / template scripts)
Registered inline script on collection template (footer, single bootstrap)
AutomaioRuntime for optional animations and interactions after load
AI content generation and visual studio

compliance.customCodeScopeUsage: Registers and applies one reviewed inline script per collection template page via Webflow custom_code API
compliance.cmsContentModel: Metadata and Page ID only; full page body is not stored as executable CMS JavaScript
